title: How the Krebs cycle powers life and death – with Nick Lane
summary: Biochemist Nick Lane gives a Royal Institution lecture arguing that the Krebs cycle is central to what makes cells alive, not just genetic information. He draws on the themes of his book Transformer to link metabolism to the origin of life, death, and aging.
why: HN commenters point to Nick Lane as an excellent science communicator whose talks on mitochondria and the chemistry of life are worth watching.

quote.text: excellent science communicator; you can watch some of his talks online.
